title: Spike: translation quality and cost on 10 MoM Stories
description:
Translate 10 real published Machines on Machines Stories into Spanish (es) and Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) with GPT-6 Luna, block by block, with a draft glossary and protected Markus (links, citations, code, names). Nothing is published.

Measure per Story and language: tokens, cost from data/model_prices.json, bilingual judge findings, deterministic fidelity findings, Humanus findings with today's English packs (are they useful on Spanish?), and a human reviewer's time and corrections.

Output: cost per Story and per changed block, the first weekly budget proposal for MoM, and a recommendation on which checks transfer. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).

comments.text: Blocked 2026-11-12: script ready (spikes/multilingual/translate_spike.py on PR #1450; sources read from MoM's public Markdown twins). The shell OPENAI_API_KEY is expired (401 expired_secret_key) and the AWS session needed to read the site key from SSM is expired. Offline estimate: the 10 Stories are 10,079 tokens; about $0.0015 per Story per language for translate plus judge at list price, before reasoning tokens. Needs a valid key or aws login to measure and produce samples.
